"""The little machine shop for Latchkey Aurora. All signals made from scratch."""
import numpy as np
from dataclasses import dataclass
pi=np.pi
SR=33452
rng=np.random.default_rng(0x1A7C4)

def hz(note): return 440*2**((note-69)/12)
def grid(secs, sr=SR): return np.arange(round(secs*sr))/sr
def close(x,t,fade=.012):
    return x*np.minimum(1,np.maximum(0,(t[-1]-t)/fade))**1.4
def onset(t, k): return 1-np.exp(-t/k)
def colored(n,sr,nodes):
    w=rng.normal(0,1,n)
    f=np.fft.rfftfreq(n,1/sr)
    curve=np.interp(f,*zip(*nodes))
    v=np.fft.irfft(np.fft.rfft(w)*curve,n=n)
    return v/(np.std(v)+1e-30)
def loopgrid(root,sr,head,cycles):
    step=round(sr*cycles/hz(root))
    f=sr*cycles/step
    st=round(head*sr)
    return np.arange(step+st)/sr, f, st, step
def normpcm(x):
    assert np.all(np.isfinite(x))
    # modest room for interpolation at pitched playback
    return np.rint(x/max(abs(x))*31100).astype('<i2')
@dataclass
class Timbre:
    name:str; label:str; pcm:object; rel:int; volume:int; pan:int; loop:tuple=(0,0)

def build():
    global rng
    rng=np.random.default_rng(0x1A7C4)
    out=[None]
    def add(name,label,signal,sr,root,vol,pan,loop=(0,0)):
        rel=round(12*np.log2(sr/8363))+60-root
        out.append(Timbre(name,label,normpcm(signal),rel,vol,pan,loop))
    # A small, fast drum machine; distinct skins, wire, metal and wood.
    t=grid(.30)
    phase=2*pi*(53.5*t+96*.029*onset(t,.029)+172*.0048*onset(t,.0048))
    knock=(.86*np.exp(-t/.070)+.35*np.exp(-t/.13))*np.sin(phase+.11*np.exp(-t/.018)*np.sin(2*phase))
    beater=colored(len(t),SR,[(0,0),(950,.01),(2370,1),(5300,.67),(9820,.04),(16000,0)])*np.exp(-t/.0038)*.137
    kick=np.tanh(1.44*(knock+beater))*onset(t,.0007)
    add('01 / copper piston','felt & sine',close(kick,t,.048),SR,60,50,128)

    t=grid(.255)
    shell=np.sin(2*pi*(178*t+81*.017*onset(t,.017))+.14)*.57*np.exp(-t/.058)
    shell+=np.sin(2*pi*(321*t+82*.013*onset(t,.013))+.6)*.21*np.exp(-t/.045)
    wires=colored(len(t),SR,[(0,0),(520,.01),(1100,.42),(1870,1),(3100,.54),(4500,.85),(7400,.55),(12600,.06),(16726,0)])
    env=.55*np.exp(-t/.062)+.12*np.exp(-t/.115)
    for pos,g in [(0,.40),(.0081,.51),(.0164,.38)]:
        dt=np.maximum(0,t-pos); env+=g*onset(dt,.0006)*np.exp(-dt/.0094)
    softer=colored(len(t),SR,[(0,0),(590,.08),(1430,1),(2950,.44),(6900,.05),(16500,0)])
    dt=np.maximum(t-.029,0); env2=.10*onset(dt,.005)*np.exp(-dt/.061)
    sn=np.tanh((shell+wires*.52*env+env2*softer)*1.72)*onset(t,.00072)
    add('02 / pleated snare','skin + foil triplet',close(sn,t,.030),SR,60,47,124)

    for op in (False,True):
        t=grid(.080 if not op else .295)
        metal=np.zeros(len(t))
        for f in [3921,4389,5359,6547,7403,9421,11091]:
            metal+=np.sin(2*pi*f*t+1.57*np.sin(2*pi*(.287*f)*t)+rng.uniform(0,2*pi))
        metal=metal/np.std(metal)
        dust=colored(len(t),SR,[(0,0),(2200,0),(4200,.22),(5840,1),(7550,.65),(9640,.90),(13200,.64),(16400,.12)])
        if op:

        if not op: add('03 / pinprick','shut iris',close(hh,t),SR,60,25,156)
        else: add('04 / brass iris','open iris',close(hh,t,.044),SR,60,24,167)

    click+=.18*colored(len(t),SR,[(0,0),(1100,.22),(2460,1),(7500,.09),(16000,0)])*np.exp(-t/.004)
    add('05 / maple relay','wood on nickel',close(np.tanh(1.53*click)*onset(t,.0007),t),SR,60,26,80)

    p=2*pi*(127*t+92*.037*onset(t,.037)+138*.0032*onset(t,.0032))

    add('06 / bakelite tom','descending ceramic',close(np.tanh(1.35*tom)*onset(t,.0009),t,.033),SR,60,35,144)

    cym=(.77*np.tanh(1.18*mist)+.23*sizzle)*(.44*np.exp(-t/.064)+.56*np.exp(-t/.259))*onset(t,.0027)
    add('07 / northern dust','powder splash',close(cym,t,.11),SR,60,27,164)

    t=grid(.421)
    narrow=colored(len(t),SR,[(0,0),(600,.01),(1550,1),(3600,.23),(7800,.01),(16500,0)])
    air=colored(len(t),SR,[(0,0),(2700,0),(5900,.8),(8550,1),(14200,.21),(16550,0)])
    u=t/t[-1]; intake=(.55*narrow*(1-u)+.76*air*u)*u**1.85
    add('08 / drawn breath','reverse glint',close(np.tanh(intake*1.25),t,.018),SR,60,26,97)

    sr=16726; root=40 # E2
